action.title: Evaluate extraction recall before relying on Agent Review Workflow claims
action.idempotency: A second execute returned the same Plane work item ID; Plane listed exactly one work item with this action as external_id.
action.readback: The next sync ingested the task and linked it by URL to the ADR-002 page and the project, and by key to FALKORDBTE-11.

decision.summary: Require human approval of agent-created work
decision.evidence_quote: Decision: require human approval of the exact payload hash before an agent creates a Plane follow-up task.
